scope: Explicit Preview/local wrappers over the existing fixed financial driver. Two-file source delta only; no operational admission, resource approval, real Preview effects or language acceptance.
observations: The shared implementation is private and target is fixed by the explicit local or Preview export. Caller network and provider/SDK network must match that target. Local target behavior and exact argument regression remain intact.
Preview rejects all three local deployment/initialized continuation shortcuts before SDK calls. Both participant addresses remain distinct, with payer matching the first role.

Preview node/indexer/indexerWS strings are restricted to the configured endpoints and proof endpoint remains loopback HTTP without credentials or fragment. Full provider binding snapshot is checked initially and inside guarded deploy/call operations.

The exact deploy/initialize/accrue/settle and deploy/initialize/swap/close arguments match the local sequence in controlled tests. Each observation and mandatory PASS comparison completes before the next SDK call. Preview explicitly passes network:preview to the observer.

Wrong target, payer, endpoint, changed binding, guarded execution failure, observation failure, failed comparison and incomplete cleanup stop progression. Known public IDs and reservation projection remain available; SDK private result canary is excluded.

Owned provider cleanup remains mandatory on preflight or runtime failure. The Preview result schema is distinct, while the local durable writer is unchanged and must not be used as an implicit Preview writer.
limitations: This is a callable fixed-sequence driver with controlled callbacks. It does not itself establish public endpoint availability, chain/genesis/protocol identity, source/profile/compiler binding, proving assets, actual signer authority, custody effects, actual reservation sufficiency or canonical finality.

Provider execute/cleanup supply bounded operation and containment semantics; the driver adds no independent outer deadline or resource admission. Integration must supply the reviewed real provider, observer, comparator and durable result path.
Existing diagnostic policy can project a newly encountered Preview preflight error as UNCLASSIFIED_DRIVER_FAILURE; no unsupported detailed error provenance is claimed.
No Preview launch/publication path or actual financial transaction is supplied by this source slice. Passing tests do not close SP05.3, mandatory PCD or the compiled Moriarty-to-Preview hard gate.
No private inputs, wallets, live RPC/network, services, build/compiler, proof generation or transaction submission were used.
